source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, that sounds and looks good. Are the spouts going to be removable? That would make cleaning them much easier. I like the press-and-dispense button, and I want each button to have a cursive "K".

value_updates.station_speed_control_placement: two top-mounted dials, one for each mixer
value_updates.dispense_control_placement: two front press-to-dispense buttons above the spout openings
value_updates.master_power_control_placement: centered on the front panel between the two dispense buttons

routing_warnings.description: The request that the buttons be functional concerns their dispensing behavior rather than control-panel placement.
Adding the on/off slot is a target-specific implementation claim for the master power control rather than the overall panel layout.
The requested silver DJ-style buttons and knobs concern decorative control styling rather than physical control-panel usability.
Recreating the rendered buttons and deck labels is a visual-styling change rather than a control-panel layout change.
